detail: DROID raw metadata has scene_id, building, task and episode id, but no declared train/test split label. D5b counts cross-split duplicate leakage; without a declared split there is no legitimate denominator or pair universe. Do not substitute a scene or date proxy without labelling it as a proxy.
candidate_pairs: D5a duplicate candidates are available from the fingerprint sample; they are not D5b leakage counts.
